title: Automatic retry attempts run on the test-run index tick thread, so an Engram outage stalls carried-gate polling and test-run indexing
outcome: Automatic retry attempts run on the test-run index tick thread, so an Engram outage stalls carried-gate polling and test-run indexing
acceptance: The retry tick dispatches due attempts to workers that own their retry slot and returns without waiting for their admission. A test shows the tick returning while an attempt is blocked in admission, with the cap, due order, panic boundary and one-attempt-per-head guard unchanged.
